approved_aspects: Prospective positive anchors restrict to surviving captured user/assistant/tool sources and canonical string fields, exact offsets/quotes, selected final question scope.
Same-source mirror cannot change event and must exactly reproduce quote; final tail accepted without requiring nonexistent checkpoint stage.
Delete operation itself cannot be positive citation; deleted original cannot support positive fact. This does not retroactively invalidate R15.
Standalone module imports only standard library and reads only supplied files; no helper/runtime/private history dependence.

findings.title: Checkpoint provenance can claim an opportunity that capture never executes
findings.repro: Generic toy first session checkpoints removed; add empty second session with checkpoint after_event_id=tail from first session. validate_gold accepts and reports capture_sequence6 as first_processing_opportunity for tail. Frozen capture only triggers after current-session events, so this checkpoint never runs.
findings.fix: Validate each checkpoint target belongs to that session before using it as provenance, with a cross-session negative test. Keep final_settle acceptance for late valid sources.

findings.title: Preserve author requirements for execution fidelity and deletion coverage explicitly
findings.evidence: Prior public receipt expressly required same-session checkpoints, inert exec_command output==event.text and deletion checks. New receipt drops these separate checks; new gold validator accepts unknown_tool with differing raw output. Negative contract only says16 deletions are accepted in toy, not required for authored set or meaningful negative questions.
findings.fix: Restore explicit author requirements and distinguish checks enforced by validator from author semantic checks. Ensure the new set retains requested deletion-negative coverage and recognized inert captures with exact raw output; add mechanical checks where appropriate. Do not claim generic anchor representability alone proves these properties.

limits: Unknown tool/differing text is not itself a canonical-field representability failure; the gap concerns promised author execution/deletion coverage, not blanket old schema invalidity.
Negative forbidden conclusion semantics remain manual; no thresholds/critical labels or source eligibility need change.
No private fixture/gold/author reads, native/model calls, runtime calls, or edits outside this new artifact.
